spec: Page numbers are 1-indexed. paginate returns the items of that page. totalPages returns how many pages exist.

bugs.desc: start should be (page - 1) * size because pages are 1-indexed
totalPages must round up (Math.ceil), floor drops the last partial page

spec: getUser must send at most one network request per id even when called concurrently, and memory use must stay bounded.

bugs.desc: Caches the result, not the promise, so concurrent calls for the same id all call fetchUser
The cache grows without limit (no size cap, TTL or eviction)

spec: Amounts are integer cents. splitBill returns one share per person and the shares must add up exactly to totalCents. people is at least 1.

bugs.desc: Rounding each share equally makes the sum differ from the total (for example 100 cents over 3 people gives 99); the remainder must be distributed

spec: findOrders returns the user's orders with the given status and a positive total. db.query returns a Promise of an array of rows.

bugs.desc: SQL injection through string interpolation of userId and status
Missing await: rows is a Promise so rows.filter throws

spec: retry runs fn at most `attempts` times in total (default 3) and waits with exponential backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms...) between tries. After the last failure it throws the error.

bugs.desc: Loop uses <= so fn runs attempts + 1 times (4 instead of 3)
Delay is a constant 100ms, not exponential

spec: unique(items) returns the items with duplicates removed, keeping the first occurrence and original order. items can contain dicts and lists.

bugs.desc: The condition is inverted: it appends items already seen (the duplicates) instead of new ones
set membership fails with TypeError for unhashable items such as dicts and lists

spec: verifySignature checks an HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature. It must not leak information to an attacker through timing.

bugs.desc: String comparison is not constant time; use crypto.timingSafeEqual

spec: nextId returns a unique increasing id. Many requests call it at the same time. db.get and db.set are async.

bugs.desc: Read-modify-write across awaits lets concurrent calls read the same value and return duplicate ids; needs an atomic increment or lock
The module-level counter is shared mutable state: after an await another call overwrites it so this call can return the wrong id

spec: Cart prices are integer cents. cart.total must always equal the sum of price * qty of the items in cart.items, minus any coupon. Totals stay integers.

bugs.desc: applyCoupon can produce fractional cents (needs rounding)

spec: daysBetween(a, b) returns the number of calendar days from local date a to local date b. a and b are Date objects at local midnight. It must be correct across daylight saving changes.

bugs.desc: A day is not always 24 hours: across a DST change the difference is 23 or 25 hours so floor gives an off-by-one; use Math.round or UTC dates

spec: clamp limits n to the range lo..hi (lo <= hi). sum adds numbers in an array. Both are correct and standard.
chunks(xs, n) splits a list into consecutive pieces of at most n items. n must be a positive integer. It is correct.
